title: Coffee run stage progress pilot
question: When a run does not deliver the coffee, does it record collection first?
hypothesis: Exploratory: describe where traces stop before proposing a confirmatory comparison.

motivation.observation: A completion rate alone cannot distinguish a run that never picked up the coffee from one that picked it up but did not deliver it.

limitations: This fixed seed block is a diagnostic pilot, not a confirmatory study.
The scripted baseline is deterministic; exact repeats do not add independent evidence.
The seeded random agent may return control instead of attempting delivery. No live model or human was compared.
